svg.aria-label: Ben-Or: consensus with a coin: When a round does not converge, everybody tosses a coin; the schedule cannot win for ever.. phase 1: my value; N − f values back: more than half equal?; phase 2: that value, or NONE; N − f proposals back; more than f equal proposals: decide; none at all: toss a coin and go round again. Agreement never depends on the coin; termination does, and its probability grows with every round.
